blocks.prompt: 21 Find the general solution of the differential equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2xy}{2y + 1} = x\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein dhoka yeh hai ke \(x\) aur \(y\) mile hue nazar aate hain, aur lagta hai yeh separable nahi.
Lekin agar \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela kar ke right side ko ek fraction banayein to \(2xy\) cancel ho jata hai aur \(\frac{x}{2y + 1}\) bachta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2xy}{2y + 1} = x\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? Simplify karne ke baad separable equation ka tareeqa.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) akela karna, common denominator, variables alag, integrate.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2xy}{2y + 1} = x\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable equation: pehle right side ko \(x\) ka hissa times \(y\) ka hissa banana, phir alag kar ke integrate karna.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) akela kar ke simplify karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = x - \dfrac{2xy}{2y + 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{x(2y + 1) - 2xy}{2y + 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{x}{2y + 1}\]
Kyun: Do terms ko minus karne ke liye common denominator \(2y + 1\) liya, is liye \(x\) ko \(\frac{x(2y + 1)}{2y + 1}\) likha. Upar \(2xy + x - 2xy = x\) bacha.
Dhyan dein: Yeh simplification hi is sawal ki chaabi hai; is ke baghair aap ise linear ya kuch aur samajh kar uljhan mein par sakte hain.

Variables alag karein
\[(2y + 1)\,dy = x\,dx\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((2y + 1)\,dx\) se multiply kiya; ab \(y\) sirf left par aur \(x\) sirf right par hai.

Integrate karein
\[\int (2y + 1)\,dy = \int x\,dx\]
\[y^2 + y = \dfrac{x^2}{2} + C\]
\[y(y + 1) = \dfrac{x^2}{2} + C\]
Kyun: Power rule: \(\int 2y\,dy = y^2\), \(\int 1\,dy = y\), \(\int x\,dx = \frac{x^2}{2}\). Dono taraf ke constants mil kar ek \(C\) ban gaye. Aakhir mein \(y\) common nikal kar key wali shakal mein likha.

Tasdeeq
Differentiate karein: \((2y + 1)y' = x\), yani \(y' = \frac{x}{2y + 1}\). Aur
\[x - \dfrac{2xy}{2y + 1} = \dfrac{x}{2y + 1}\]
is liye di hui equation poori hoti hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Jawab se nikla \(y'\) aur equation se nikla \(y'\) dono ek jaise hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 24 par chhapa hai, 21 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 24 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(y(y + 1) = \frac{1}{2}x^2 + C\), sahi hai.
